difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the flat pullback of the divisor of a rational function on an integral scheme as the divisor of the same function on the source (statement lines 2589-2600, tag 02RU-adjacent). The proof reduces to a coefficient comparison at an integral closed subscheme of codimension one, passes to the two local rings at the generic points, which form a flat local homomorphism of one-dimensional Noetherian local domains, and identifies the two coefficients as an order times a length and an order, equal by the length formula for flat local maps. The reduction to the local statement is the substance, so the claim is H2.
